name: agent-loop-sidecar-tcp-binding-mismatch
about: modules.agentLoop 绑定 module-tcp-v2，但 implementationId 与 sidecar 握手报的模块身份不同（bbx.other-loop）：客户端在 hello 应答后按 expectedModuleId 拒绝（agentLoopSidecarClient.ts:810-813，AgentLoopDeploymentProfile.ts:112），execute 没发出，不写 agent_loop_operation_* 记录，轮次以这条错误失败；同一会话再提交一次结果相同。另一个会话在端口没人监听时按绑定的 connectTimeoutMs 失败于 connect。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  agentLoop:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.other-loop
    contract: pilotdeck.agent-loop/v1
    transport: module-tcp-v2
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 38414
    connectTimeoutMs: 2000
